sentences.text: This Writ Petition is filed questioning the action of the respondent No.6 in removing the canal of Urravva Chervu at Mulkanoor village without obtaining permission from the respondent No.7 and also acquiring the house of the petitioner bearing No.6-16/1 and without paying any compensation.

2. Heard the learned Counsel for the petitioner as well as the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Panchayath Raj and Rural Development, appearing for the respondents.
3. The learned Assistant Government Pleader basing on the counter filed by the respondent No.6 would submit that the respondent No.6 never interfered with the petitioner's alleged house,
however, a general notice was issued on the instructions of the R&B authorities to SK,J the dwellers abutting to the said road but not initiated any action.
4.

In view of the submissions made by the learned Assistant Government Pleader this Writ Petition is disposed of directing the respondent-authorities not to interfere with the possession of the petitioner over the subject property, without following due process of law.

If the respondent-authorities wants to acquire the same, they have to follow the rules as contemplated under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013

sentences.text: 5. As sequel to it, Miscellaneous Petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
